# lowering

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/internal/lowering"
```

Package lowering replaces checked expressions with equivalent Go statements.

The driver supplies source syntax, checked types, bindings, and TGo operation records. LowerPropagations handles propagation and if values. It returns formatted Go file contents; the driver writes owned generated files.

The lowerer evaluates each call once, checks its error at that point, and returns on failure before later operands run. It saves earlier operands when needed. Branch work stays in the selected branch, loop work keeps its repeated execution, and assignment destinations keep their original storage.

Saved values use explicit checked types and fresh local names. Propagation checks the original error result before return conversion. Returns, defers, and jumps retain their source function and targets. If branches that leave the function or jump out need no result assignment.

InsertAfter is a separate operation for ordinary Go. It inserts a caller's statements after one selected expression. Both operations build changed syntax without changing the checked input, so callers can make several rewrites from one source. Module selection and disk writes belong to the driver or caller.

### func Load

```go
func Load(dir, pattern string) (*Source, error)
```

Load reads and type\-checks one Go package selected by pattern in dir. It records expression positions for later statement insertion.

### func SourceFromCheckedPackage

SourceFromCheckedPackage records expressions from private source checking.

### func SourceFromPackage

```go
func SourceFromPackage(p *packages.Package, dir string) (*Source, error)
```

SourceFromPackage records expression positions and insertion limits in a checked package. File names are relative to dir; a package with type errors returns an error.

### func \(\*Source\) InsertAfter

```go
func (s *Source) InsertAfter(site Site, after After) (map[string][]byte, error)
```

InsertAfter returns Go files with the callback's statements after the selected expression. The callback receives saved results; the original syntax tree stays unchanged.

### func \(\*Source\) LowerPropagations

```go
func (s *Source) LowerPropagations(operations map[string]Propagation) (map[string][]byte, error)
```

LowerPropagations replaces checked propagation and if values with ordinary Go. It returns formatted file contents by absolute path without writing files. It reports an error if any accepted operation was not replaced.
